title_zh: 京张统一品牌、贡献记录与可逆公共空间组件架构
title_en: Jing-Zhang Unified Brand, Contribution Record, and Reversible Public-Space Component Architecture

artifact_status.scope_note_zh: 本文件只证明提案内部的品牌、活动、贡献记录、地标、组件与交付证据门结构完整。它不是正式标识发布、政府授权、实施主体确认、场地测绘、预算安排、采购事实、建设文件、运行记录、获奖名单或成效证明。
artifact_status.scope_note_en: This file proves only the internal structure of the proposal's brand, events, contribution record, landmarks, components, and delivery evidence gates. It is not a released official identity, government authorization, confirmed operator, site survey, budget arrangement, procurement fact, construction document, operating record, award list, or evidence of outcomes.

master_brand.promise_zh: 从自主筑路到自主用智：让一项城市 AI 能力先在可选择、可接管、可申诉、可退出的公共条件下被证明。
master_brand.promise_en: From independent railway engineering to trusted AI at city scale: prove one urban AI capability first under public conditions of choice, takeover, appeal, and exit.
master_brand.endorsement_rule_zh: 所有旗舰、活动、贡献记录、地标与组件都使用同一主品牌背书，不另立总体品牌。
master_brand.endorsement_rule_en: Every flagship, event, contribution record, landmark, and component is endorsed by this one master brand; none becomes another umbrella brand.

logo_direction.design_rule_zh: 以一条铁路主干连接向前分支与回程折线；开放括号表示城市规则仍可修订，人工节点表示最终责任不交给模型。
logo_direction.design_rule_en: A railway trunk joins a forward branch and a return switchback; an open bracket keeps civic rules amendable, while a human node keeps final responsibility with people rather than a model.

elements.meaning_zh: 百年京张的工程连续性
elements.meaning_en: engineering continuity across the Jing-Zhang century

elements.meaning_zh: 面向真实城市任务的应用开路
elements.meaning_en: opening a path into a real urban task

elements.meaning_zh: 失败、退出、纠错与能力返还
elements.meaning_en: failure, exit, correction, and capability return

elements.meaning_zh: 可公开阅读并持续修订的城市规则
elements.meaning_en: public-readable and continuously amendable civic rules

elements.meaning_zh: 可见的人工接管、决定与补救责任
elements.meaning_en: visible human authority for takeover, decisions, and remedy

flagship_programs.name_zh: 大钟寺 AI 日常市场

operating_rituals.purpose_zh: 让公众体验有人与非数字路径、查看边界并提出问题。
operating_rituals.purpose_en: Let the public try staffed and non-digital paths, inspect boundaries, and raise questions.

operating_rituals.purpose_zh: 独立复核通过、失败、不确定性、申诉与退出证据。
operating_rituals.purpose_en: Independently review passes, failures, uncertainty, appeals, and exit evidence.

operating_rituals.purpose_zh: 公开年度版本、贡献、纠错、能力返还与下一年度问题清单。
operating_rituals.purpose_en: Publish the annual version, contributions, corrections, capability returns, and next-year problem list.

operating_rituals.purpose_zh: 持续保留版本、暂停、退出、纠错与回应状态。
operating_rituals.purpose_en: Continuously retain version, pause, exit, correction, and response status.

honor_system.recognition_rule_zh: 记录可核验的公共贡献与纠错，不以个人声望、企业规模、单次活动人数或模型榜单排序。任何未来记录都须取得授权并允许更正、撤回和申诉。
honor_system.recognition_rule_en: Record verifiable public contribution and correction without ranking by personal prestige, company size, one-off attendance, or model league tables. Any future entry requires authorization and routes for correction, withdrawal, and appeal.

categories.evidence_zh: 清楚提出一项可被现场确认、具有人工基线的公共问题。
categories.evidence_en: Clearly frame one public problem that can be confirmed in context against a human baseline.

categories.evidence_zh: 贡献经清权、可复核、可迁移的方法、接口、组件或工具。
categories.evidence_en: Contribute a rights-cleared, reviewable, and portable method, interface, component, or tool.

categories.evidence_zh: 独立发布通过、失败、不确定性与可复现方法。
categories.evidence_en: Independently publish passes, failures, uncertainty, and reproducible methods.

categories.evidence_zh: 使选择、有人服务、申诉、补救、删除或退出权在真实流程中可用。
categories.evidence_en: Make choice, staffed service, appeal, remedy, deletion, or exit usable in a real process.

categories.evidence_zh: 公开失败、完成纠错或把方法、资产、数据与服务能力返还公共体系。
categories.evidence_en: Disclose failure, complete correction, or return methods, assets, data, and service capacity to the public system.

landmarks.role_zh: 低门槛 SOURCE/PROVE 验证亭
可公开旁观、可人工急停的 STACK/PROVE 观察庭
landmarks.role_en: STACK/PROVE observation court with public viewing and human emergency stop

landmarks.role_zh: 保存贡献、纠错、退出与失败证据的 LIVE & MARKET—COMMONS 公共廊
landmarks.role_en: LIVE & MARKET-to-COMMONS public gallery retaining contributions, corrections, exits, and failures

cross_cutting_operations.boundary_zh: AI City API、公约、七接口与能力返还机制是横贯五旗舰和三地标的可信运行层，不是第二主品牌、认证、监管通行证或政府平台。
cross_cutting_operations.boundary_en: The AI City API, compact, seven interfaces, and capability-return mechanism are the trusted operations layer across five flagships and three landmarks—not a second master brand, certification, regulatory pass, or government platform.

items.name_zh: 京张 AI 可信应用公约

trusted_interfaces.name_zh: 人工接管与无 AI 服务
版本、暂停、退出与公共记忆
trusted_interfaces.name_en: Version, Pause, Exit, and Public Memory

components.purpose_zh: 把 AI 辅助、有人服务和非数字路径并列呈现，不以智能手机或账户作为进入条件。
components.purpose_en: Present AI-assisted, staffed, and non-digital routes side by side without requiring a smartphone or account for entry.

reversibility.description_zh: 使用可移动标识、地面导向和家具，不改变既有人工入口。
reversibility.description_en: Use movable signs, floor guidance, and furniture without altering the existing staffed entrance.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 等价路径、清晰对比、可触达信息、无障碍回转与有人协助均待现场和专业核验。
accessibility.requirements_en: Equivalent routes, clear comparison, reachable information, accessible turning, and staffed assistance await site and professional verification.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 移除导向组件，恢复清楚可用的原有人工作业线，并把组件与变更记录返还责任保管角色。
removal_return_rule.action_en: Remove the guidance kit, restore the legible staffed baseline, and return components and change records to the accountable custodian role.

components.purpose_zh: 以通俗双语说明系统身份、来源、数据目的、版本、能力边界与责任角色。
components.purpose_en: Explain system identity, provenance, data purpose, version, capability limits, and accountable role in plain bilingual language.

reversibility.description_zh: 采用可替换版面与可移动支架，使版本和运营变化不需永久改造。
reversibility.description_en: Use replaceable panels and movable mounts so versions and operating changes require no permanent alteration.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 要求通俗语言、可触达阅读高度、视觉与触觉冗余、多语和替代格式，均待专业核验。
accessibility.requirements_en: Require plain language, reachable reading heights, visual and tactile redundancy, multilingual content, and alternative formats, all pending professional review.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 撤下失效版面，封存版本与来源记录，恢复原有空间信息系统并返还可复用构件。
removal_return_rule.action_en: Remove obsolete panels, archive version and provenance records, restore the existing spatial information system, and return reusable parts.

components.purpose_zh: 提供可见的人工说明、接管、确认、投诉与无 AI 等价服务。
components.purpose_en: Provide visible human explanation, takeover, confirmation, complaint handling, and equivalent non-AI service.

reversibility.description_zh: 使用可移动、可调节的服务台和遮蔽屏，不假定新建固定房间。
reversibility.description_en: Use movable, adjustable counters and privacy screens without assuming a new permanent room.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 坐站双高度、助听与替代沟通、等候座位、隐私和清晰通行均待专业核验。
accessibility.requirements_en: Seated and standing heights, hearing and communication alternatives, waiting seats, privacy, and clear circulation await professional review.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 完成案件交接与服务连续性记录后移走家具，恢复不低于 D0 的有人服务基线。
removal_return_rule.action_en: After case handover and service-continuity recording, remove furniture and restore a staffed baseline no worse than D0.

components.purpose_zh: 以纸质或可迁移格式提供版本、人工决定、申诉、删除、退出与交接回执。
components.purpose_en: Issue paper or portable receipts for version, human decision, appeal, deletion, exit, and handover.

reversibility.description_zh: 由可移动文件架、打印或盖章工具和离线模板组成，不绑定单一供应商。
reversibility.description_en: Combine movable document storage, print or stamping tools, and offline templates without locking into one supplier.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 纸质、可读文本、口头说明与辅助格式须等价，领取高度、隐私与队列待专业核验。
accessibility.requirements_en: Paper, readable text, spoken explanation, and assistive formats must be equivalent; collection height, privacy, and queues await professional review.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 完成合法保留、删除、导出和未结案件交接后，移除设备并返还模板与可复用部件。
removal_return_rule.action_en: After lawful retention, deletion, export, and open-case handover, remove equipment and return templates and reusable parts.

components.purpose_zh: 让现场人工权责、自动功能状态、暂停动作和安全边界同时可见。
components.purpose_en: Make on-site human authority, automation state, pause action, and safety boundary visible together.

reversibility.description_zh: 采用独立可移除的状态灯、物理停止器和临时安全界面；正式工程方案待专业确认。
reversibility.description_en: Use independent removable state lights, physical stops, and temporary safety interfaces; a formal engineered solution awaits professional confirmation.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 状态须以视觉、听觉与触觉冗余表达，急停可达性和误触防护待专业核验。
accessibility.requirements_en: State needs visual, audible, and tactile redundancy; reachability and accidental-trigger protection await professional review.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 先冻结自动功能并验证安全状态，再拆除临时界面、封存事件记录并恢复原设施。
removal_return_rule.action_en: Freeze automation and verify a safe state before removing the temporary interface, archiving incident records, and restoring the original facility.

components.purpose_zh: 以可替换、可纠错的时间轨记录公共问题、开放构建、独立验证、权利守护和失败返还。
components.purpose_en: Use a replaceable, correctable timeline to record public problems, open builds, independent verification, rights safeguards, and failure returns.

reversibility.description_zh: 使用可拆轨道、可替换证据卡和独立档案索引，不制作不可更正的永久荣誉墙。
reversibility.description_en: Use demountable rails, replaceable evidence cards, and an independent archive index rather than an uncorrectable permanent honor wall.

accessibility.requirements_zh: 时间线须支持触觉、多语、易读与替代格式，公众更正和撤回路径清晰可达。
accessibility.requirements_en: The timeline must support tactile, multilingual, easy-read, and alternative formats with reachable public correction and withdrawal routes.

removal_return_rule.action_zh: 更正或撤下展示卡，保留授权范围内的版本与撤回记录，把构件和档案索引移交公共保管角色。
removal_return_rule.action_en: Correct or remove display cards, retain authorized version and withdrawal records, and hand components and the archive index to the public custodian role.

delivery_hold_points.name_zh: 公共问题与 D0 人工基线
delivery_hold_points.name_en: Public Problem and D0 Human Baseline
required_evidence_zh: 经现场共同确认的一项公共问题
普通人工或非数字服务的 D0 定义与观测计划
不得自动作出的决定与受影响群体边界
required_evidence_en: one public problem co-confirmed in context
a D0 definition and observation plan for the ordinary staffed or non-digital service
the boundary of prohibited automated decisions and affected groups

delivery_hold_points.name_zh: 场地、权属、责任角色、预算与采购路径
delivery_hold_points.name_en: Site, Ownership, Accountable Roles, Budget, and Procurement Route
required_evidence_zh: 经测绘的载体与权属或使用许可
可签字的责任、运营、维护与保管角色
依法确认的资金来源、预算上限与采购或合作路径
required_evidence_en: a surveyed carrier and ownership or use permission
signable accountability, operations, maintenance, and custody roles
a lawfully confirmed funding source, budget ceiling, and procurement or collaboration route

delivery_hold_points.name_zh: 数据、安全、无障碍与非数字服务
delivery_hold_points.name_en: Data, Safety, Accessibility, and Non-Digital Service
required_evidence_zh: 数据来源、授权、最小化、留存与删除方案
消防、市政、能源、交通与现场安全专业复核
无障碍与等价有人或非数字服务核验
required_evidence_en: data provenance, authorization, minimization, retention, and deletion plan
professional fire, utility, energy, transport, and on-site safety review
verification of accessibility and equivalent staffed or non-digital service

delivery_hold_points.name_zh: 独立证据、申诉与有效补救
delivery_hold_points.name_en: Independent Evidence, Appeal, and Effective Remedy
required_evidence_zh: 与供应、运营或采购决定相分离的评测安排
可追踪申诉、人工决定、时限与补救路径
成功、失败、不确定性、事件和退出的公开证据计划
required_evidence_en: evaluation separated from supply, operations, or procurement decisions
a trackable appeal, human decision, service clock, and remedy route
a public evidence plan for success, failure, uncertainty, incidents, and exit

required_evidence_zh: 与设计审查或测试通过相分离的正式授权
停止、退出、人工服务恢复、数据处置和资产返还计划
开放问题、案件、版本、组件与公共记录交接
required_evidence_en: formal authorization separate from design review or test passage
a stop, exit, staffed-service restoration, data disposition, and asset-return plan
handover of open issues, cases, versions, components, and public records

evidence_boundary.rule_zh: 以上任一实施证据缺失，相关地标或组件必须停止推进或保持 concept_only；结构完整不等于实施可行、获批、已采购、已建成或取得成效。
evidence_boundary.rule_en: If any implementation evidence above is missing, the relevant landmark or component must stop or remain concept_only; structural completeness does not mean feasible delivery, approval, procurement, construction, or achieved outcomes.

structural_claims.claim_boundary_zh: 这些数值只计数本文件中的提案结构，不是运行、绩效、预算、建设或获批指标。
structural_claims.claim_boundary_en: These values count proposal structures in this file only; they are not operating, performance, budget, construction, or approval metrics.
